name: @w6w-apps/prospeo
description: Find and enrich B2B people and companies with Prospeo: enrich or bulk-enrich persons and companies, search the lead database, resolve filter values, and read credit balance.

w6w.longDescription:
Prospeo is a B2B contact and company data platform. This app enriches a person (verified work email, optionally mobile) or a company from whatever you know about them, singly or in batches of up to 50, and searches Prospeo's lead and company database with its 40+ filters, up to 25 results per page.

It also resolves the exact filter values the search endpoints demand (locations, job titles, technologies, industries, NAICS/SIC codes and more) and reads your plan and remaining credits, which is free.

Health checks verify the API key, whether api.prospeo.io is answering, and credit headroom. Prospeo publishes no vendor status page, so none is declared.
